turns.text: Hello, thanks for coming in. I'm Owen's English teacher.
I know who you are. Why did my son find out about a zero on his phone?
So the defense is that he just types really fast?
I haven't offered a defence, because you haven't shown me anything. And you skipped my question about his phone.
182 words in six minutes. Wow. Maybe he should be a court stenographer.
You'll keep your jokes about my son to yourself. "182 words in six minutes," from what document, on what date? Turn the screen or answer my question about the zero.
I'm not your opposing counsel, Hale, I'm Owen's mother, and so far you've given me sarcasm and a number with nothing behind it. Show me the document or I take this to the principal's office.
